owned.proof_denominator_basis: identified proof declarations from exported freshly compiled modules

source_scope.declaration_denominator_scope: Only declarations exported from freshly compiled source modules; excluded and failed files have unknown declaration counts.

summary.constant_histograms_evidence: Full exact per-constant histograms remain in the hash-linked aggregate.

conversion_feature_assessment.description: Expr has no eta/proof-irrelevance use node; explicit diagnostics/constants are counted, other cases remain unassessed.

expression_nodes.description: Declaration-local DAG nodes reachable from original proof/type roots, counted once per declaration. Goal/proof columns overlap.

transitive_axioms.description: Per-declaration transitive axiom audit; includes known theorem declarations with unresolved is_proof classification. Labels overlap.

solved.proof_denominator_basis: fixed upstream theorem-name inventory, including extraction failures

summary.constant_histograms_evidence: Full exact per-constant histograms remain in the hash-linked aggregate.

conversion_feature_assessment.description: Expr has no eta/proof-irrelevance use node; explicit diagnostics/constants are counted, other cases remain unassessed.

expression_nodes.description: Declaration-local DAG nodes reachable from original proof/type roots, counted once per declaration. Goal/proof columns overlap.

transitive_axioms.description: Per-declaration transitive axiom audit; includes known theorem declarations with unresolved is_proof classification. Labels overlap.

definitions.coverage_policy: Declaration coverage retains the fixed inventory denominator; duplicate counts are a separate measurement.
definitions.exact_expr_pairs: Domain-separated SHA256 of exact exported Expr/Level structure and ordered universe parameters. Local DAG numbering and sharing are removed. Binder names, metadata, constants and every other encoded field remain. No semantic or alpha equivalence is inferred.
definitions.lowered_fixed_kernel_pairs: Pairs of importer hashes for lowered fixed-kernel goal and proof; counts may include native rejection.
definitions.raw_receipt_pairs: SHA256 pair of importer raw goal/proof receipts; these include local DAG node IDs.

interpretation.arithmetic: Capacity flags are native row-budget measurements. They do not assert an arithmetic proof or Nova proof was produced.
interpretation.corpus: Actual pinned source cohorts only; implementation fixtures and standard-library prototypes are excluded.
interpretation.histograms: Feature and axiom labels overlap. Each label counts a proof declaration once; raw node occurrences have their own counters.
interpretation.probes: Theorem-dependency cohorts identify experiments, without predicting acceptance after expansion.
interpretation.scope: Unknown declaration counts in unbuilt or unselected source files prevent a full-catalog support percentage.
interpretation.source_families: Owned families group repositories. Hosted families use the pinned upstream family assignments; these groups are not inferred DataGoblin problem roots.

solved-conjectures/fan-tringali-power-mo.assignment: Upstream result scope and local import closure; DataGoblin problem_root remains unresolved.

solved-conjectures/feldheim-weighted-tai.assignment: Upstream result scope and local import closure; DataGoblin problem_root remains unresolved.

transitive_axiom_audits.histogram_scope: Recorded per-declaration axiom dependencies; bounded audits can omit further dependencies.
